interface.shortDescription: Traverse graph-first Learn, Idea, Feature, Implement, and Audit workflows.
interface.longDescription: SE2 is an experimental issue-first, graph-first plugin with explicit durable-context, Idea capture, Feature planning, GitHub-Feature-to-PR implementation, and live session Audit entry points. Learn performs only authorized local-repository context changes and has no external dependency preflight. Idea publishes hosted Ideas by default through G, with local preview as an opt-in. Feature converges authoritative Feature issues, vertical Task issues, stable bracketed acceptance-criterion IDs, acyclic Task dependency graphs, and an explicit terminal preview/publish/reconciliation subgraph with publish as the default. Idea, Feature, and Implement share one portable-content safety gate immediately before every hosted write; SE2 owns semantic projection while G owns transport and readback. Implement coordinates a Sol/medium control plane with adaptive Sol workers, criterion-level evidence bound to exact candidate HEADs, mandatory GitHub-backed source and PR delivery, separate execution waves from standalone or stacked delivery, maps Git and GitHub transport to G-owned workflows, gates stacked children on a green exact-HEAD parent, reconciles parent drift, routes defective specifications through Feature Contract Repair, and keeps a minimal SQLite WAL recovery ledger. An explicit SE2 GitHub request implicitly authorizes the exact in-scope hosted writes required by its selected workflow; merge, deploy, release, and post-merge closure remain outside the default scope. Audit observes active SE2 sessions read-only, reconstructs workflow-graph conformance from positive evidence, and reports feedback, bugs, regressions, graph violations, and graph-design improvements without persistent state. Root contracts standardize graph vocabulary, live task preflight, destination and identity observation, bounded display-title reconciliation, update relay, and recovery.
defaultPrompt: Use $se2:learn for durable repository knowledge or $se2:idea for transient capture and explicit GitHub publication.
Use $se2:feature to plan or repair authoritative GitHub Features and Task DAGs through its graph-first workflow.
Use $se2:implement for verified standalone or stacked Feature-to-PR delivery, or $se2:audit to monitor active SE2 graph runs read-only.
